name: Research2 R2-10 Causal Working-Set Predictor -- Phase-0 Benchmark Contract

upstream.audit_verdict: CASE C / RESOLVED BY PAPER AMENDMENT
upstream.note: This contract does not redefine the primary_target, causal boundary (intrastep_cross_layer_causal_context), horizons, or primary_metric_cutoff already frozen in experiments/R2-09-prediction-benchmark/prediction_contract.json and metrics_contract.json under r2-09b-contract-v1.1 -- it binds to them by digest and adds only what R2-09B explicitly left open for R2-10: the predictor candidate grid, null/trivial baselines, the deterministic output-contract implementation, aggregation rule, DEV-only selection rule, and acceptance/interpretation categories.

purpose: Freeze, before any predictor is run or DEV results exist, the exact experimental contract for the R2-10 causal working-set predictor tournament: causal boundary (adopted), target definition (adopted), output contract, metrics/aggregation, DEV/EVAL protocol, candidate predictor families with finite grids, null/trivial baselines, selection rule, and interpretation categories. Prevents R2-10 from winning by construction and prevents EVAL-influenced predictor/configuration selection.
scientific_question: Can strictly causal information available before a routing decision predict future expert demand well enough to support a retention policy that can later be tested (R2-11) against the strong causal baseline established by R2-09A?
non_goals_this_phase: No predictor is implemented for the full DEV tournament in Phase 0 beyond the reference null/trivial baselines needed to make the leakage/determinism/output-contract tests executable.
No EVAL data is opened, read, or referenced beyond the already-frozen R2-09B eval_manifest.json acquisition contract.
No retention policy (R2-11) is implemented or evaluated.
No runtime/throughput/latency claim is made (reserved for R2-12).
R2-09A and R2-09B frozen evidence are not modified; this contract only reads them.

scope_boundary.r2_10_full_tournament: NOT STARTED -- gated on this Phase-0 contract passing its own tests, per the handoff instruction not to begin the full tournament merely because contract tests pass.
scope_boundary.r2_11: FUTURE -- explicitly forbidden to start in this phase

r2_10_does_not_claim: the R2-09A comparator gap is a proven maximum causal opportunity
